name: The Brass Age
pages: The {b}Brass Age{/} is the mid-game stage of Create: Genesis. This begins once the player has access to {b}the Nether{/} and lasts until they gain access to {b}the End{/}.{pb}In the Brass Age, most materials become accessible, farms can be automated at a much larger scale, and {!}electrical technology{/} is unlocked.

To kick off the Brass Age, you'll need to visit the Nether and search out a {b}Nether Fortress{/}, where {b}blazes{/} can spawn. Fill an {i}empty blaze burner{/} by capturing a blaze, which converts it into a {i}blaze burner{/} you can use to advance your technology.{pb}{i}Blaze burners{/} can provide heat to a {i}basin{/} or {i}fluid tank{/} it's placed under, allowing you to craft new items (including {i}brass{/}) or build {i}steam engines{/} for more rotational power.

Brass components, such as {i}mechanical arms{/}, {i}smart chutes{/}, {i}brass funnels{/}, etc. will expand your automation capabilities with more advanced filters and functions. Not least of these is the {i}mechanical crafter{/}, which can be used to fully automate all crafting recipes.{pb}Most of the game's features can be enjoyed in the Brass Age, but a few features are reserved for the {l:progression/netherite_age}Netherite Age{/l}.
